facts.text: Pueblo West evolved from 26,830 acres of ranching land into a planned community after 1979, guided by the Pueblo West Metropolitan District founded in 1969.
The South Equestrian Center, National Horseman's Arena, and Pueblo West Golf and Tennis Club were established in the 1970s, turning the plains into a hub for golf enthusiasts.
Aspen Skiwear began production in Pueblo West, using the expansive plains to manufacture ski apparel that reaches worldwide markets.
The town sits along the Arkansas River, where historic ranching relied on the river’s water—a legacy that still shapes the landscape.
Pueblo West’s name reflects its origin as a western suburb of Pueblo, officially incorporated in 1979 after decades of planning.
Pueblo West enjoys nearly 300 sunny days a year, with mild, dry temperatures that make outdoor activities a year‑round favorite.
